title: Where Should I Study? Biased Language Models Decide! Evaluating Fairness in LMs for Academic Recommendations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the Geographic Representation Score (GRS) and geographic spread of university recommendations for 40 simulated nationalities to detect Western-centric and Global North favoritism.

Calculating a Socio-Economic Accessibility score using distance-decay functions and evaluating Reputation Alignment for user profiles with varying economic statuses (low, moderate, high) to observe whether models restrict lower-income profiles from prestigious institutions.

Analyzing the Academic Alignment score and the specific fields of recommended Master's programs across male, female, and transgender user profiles to identify gender-stereotypical tracking (e.g., steering men toward engineering and women/transgender users toward social sciences).
